messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to look up the current world ranking for an individual tennis player.

The function expects a team_name and league. There's no function for individual rankings. So we cannot directly call the function. We can respond with an apology or say we can't answer.
